Framna is looking for an Art Director to join our global marketing team. You will help shape our creative direction, develop and produce campaign concepts, elevate our website and other channels, and create attention-grabbing film and motion content.

The team and the role

Framna’s brand is entering a new chapter, with bigger ambitions than ever. We are growing our global marketing team to make them real.

You will work as a creative pair with our Copywriter and Content Lead, developing concepts and campaigns together. You will also collaborate with designers, marketing colleagues and product teams across Framna.

We are ambitious about AI, both in the products we build and in our creative work. You already use AI tools and enjoy exploring their possibilities, combining them with your own taste and judgment.

What you will work on

• Develop campaign concepts that connect our marketing priorities with what matters to the audience.

• Take projects from early ideas to delivery, identifying what’s needed and involving the right colleagues.

• Design and produce content for our website, social channels, newsletters, paid media, events and sales materials.

• Produce film and motion, including editing and animation.

• Work with marketing and commercial teams to develop content and materials that explain our offering and show our work.

Working here

Let's have a talk and find the best solution together.

**This is a chance to join a European scale-up with proven traction, a high-performance culture, and leadership committed to your success.

**

jobs.occupation: Team Leader, Evening Shift - Fruit & Vegetables Salling Group, Terminal Holme
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy bringing people together, creating structure and making things happen? Are you motivated by developing others while ensuring that daily operations run smoothly – even when things get busy? Then you might be our new Team Leader for the evening shift in Fruit & Vegetables at Terminal Holme.

At Salling Group, we believe that good leadership is not just about having a title. It is about taking responsibility, setting clear expectations and helping others succeed.

We are looking for a leader who understands that strong performance and employee well-being go hand in hand.

**Your role – leading people and delivering results

**As Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily operations of our evening shift, working closely with the Department Manager and your fellow leaders.Our evening shift operates from 12:00 to 20:00, and you will play a key role in ensuring that our colleagues have the right conditions to succeed and that our stores receive their deliveries on time.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop your team: Create direction, communicate expectations, provide feedback and support the development of colleagues and future leaders.

• Ensure strong daily operations: Plan staffing and resources, coordinate priorities and maintain an efficient operation with a high level of delivery accuracy.

• Drive continuous improvement: Challenge existing routines, involve colleagues in finding better solutions and use KPIs and LEAN principles to improve performance.

• Take ownership of safety and well-being: Create a working environment where everyone is treated with respect, safety comes first and challenges are addressed rather than ignored.

• Follow up and take action: Conduct daily team meetings, follow up on productivity, absence and performance, and ensure that decisions turn into action.

You will report to the Department Manager and become part of the Team Leader group at Terminal Holme.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who wants to make a difference – both for the business and for the people they lead.

You are comfortable making decisions, including the difficult ones, and you understand that being a good leader sometimes means having honest conversations.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from warehouse operations, logistics or a similar operational environment.

• Have leadership experience or have demonstrated a strong ability to lead and develop others.

• Communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Danish.

• Are structured, solution-oriented and able to maintain an overview when priorities change.

• Take responsibility, follow through on commitments and lead by example.

Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in people. You listen, involve your colleagues and are willing to challenge them when needed.

We do not expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to take ownership, be curious and have the courage to act.

What can you expect from us?

At Terminal Holme, we supply fresh fruit and vegetables to Bilka and føtex stores across Jutland and Funen.

You will join an international working environment with colleagues from many different backgrounds, where English is a natural part of everyday communication. Our operations run around the clock, and strong collaboration across shifts is essential.

You will become part of a leadership team that values open dialogue, accountability and continuous development.

Our leadership culture is built around a Culture of Care – where we care about our colleagues, challenge each other constructively and never compromise on safety or respect.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we work, develop your own leadership skills and contribute to building an even stronger team.

As part of Salling Group, you will also have access to our employee benefits programme, offering a range of attractive discounts and benefits across Salling Group's stores and businesses.

**Ready to take responsibility?

**If you recognise yourself in this description, we would like to hear from you.Apply here. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact:Kasper Dyndegaard MunkDepartment Manager – Fruit & VegetablesPhone: +45 61 77 33 75We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics
jobs.description:
Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Professor”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Fellowship in Experimental Quantum Matter
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Fellowship in Experimental Quantum Matter Quantum Matter Lab, Niels Bohr Institute Faculty of SCIENCE University of Copenhagen The Quantum Matter Lab at the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, invites applicants for a postdoctoral fellowship to investigate topologically protected synthetic matter in 1D and 2D arrays of semiconductor-superconductor Josephson junctions formed in a variety of lattices. The project aims to explore novel states and dynamics of emergent quantum states, including topological matter and flat bands. The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The project 

  The work is at the border of quantum simulation and quantum matter and takes advantage of novel epitaxial hybrid materials. Candidates should have a PhD in condensed matter experimental physics, mesoscopic electron transport, or experimental solid-state quantum information science. The project combines nanofabrication, low-temperature measurements using a cryofree dilution refrigerator, low-noise and high frequency electrical measurement techniques, data analysis, and close collaboration with theoretical physicists. Scientific writing and communication will be in English.

  Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Saulius Vaitiekėnas (saulius@nbi.ku.dk).

  Description of the scientific environment

  The Quantum Matter Lab at the Niels Bohr Institute is a research group focused on experimental solid-state physics, quantum nanoelectronics, and condensed matter device physics. The group provides a vibrant scientific environment for cutting-edge experimental research, with close interactions with theorists and potential collaborations with industry.

  Our group is part of Condensed Matter Physics at the Niels Bohr Institute, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. We are based in Copenhagen and offer creative, stimulating working conditions within a dynamic, international research environment.

  The University and the group wish our staff to reflect on the diversity of society and thus welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

  Terms of employment 

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week. The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 2 years, with a possibility of extending the contract further.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we’re life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Your impact begins here

**As Trial Insights Manager in Trial Performance Insights, you will lead the analysis that shapes where global Phase I–IV clinical trials run. You will turn data from multiple sources into clear, evidence-based country allocation recommendations for trial planners and Clinical Operations teams. Your work will inform feasibility, enrolment forecasts and operational decisions, helping trials start on solid ground and move forward at pace for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s degree or equivalent in life sciences, data science, statistics, economics, engineering, business administration or another relevant field.

• Significant experience in one or more of the following areas: analytics, clinical operations, trial planning, feasibility, data science, consulting or related R&D business support.

• Strong analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills, and the ability to handle complexity and ambiguity with limited predefined procedures.

• Strong experience with analytical tools such as SQL, Power BI, Python, R, Excel or similar is preferred; alternatively, a strong background in clinical operations is equally valued.

• Experience with scenario modelling, analytical tool development, data integration, dashboards or reproducible analytics.

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating complex data into business recommendations.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with clear communication and presentation skills.

• A quality mindset focused on traceability, reproducibility and documentation.

• The ability to coach or guide less experienced colleagues.

• Training in advanced analytics, project management, clinical trial operations or data engineering.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as a lead analytical contributor in trial support, running complex analyses and selected projects with trial planners, Clinical Operations and stakeholders inside and outside TP-AP.

• Lead analytical work packages that support country allocation, feasibility assessment, enrolment forecasting and operational decisions for global Phase I–IV trials.

• Define analytical approaches, integrate multiple data sources and run scenario analyses to deliver robust outputs for medium and high-complexity trial planning questions.

• Develop and quality assure analytical input on country allocation scenarios, recruitment assumptions and operational feasibility.

• Translate data and operational insight into clear recommendations, and facilitate data-driven dialogue that explains assumptions and builds alignment.

• Plan, scope and deliver analytical projects, including stakeholder mapping, timelines and risk identification.

• Build, test and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, reusable code and data pipelines, and drive automation and scalability of methods and outputs.

• Document assumptions, data sources, limitations, methodology and review steps transparently, and help shape standards for data, analytics and quality review.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Trial Performance Insights in Research & Development, where colleagues bring together curiosity, data, technology and collaboration to help advance scientific ideas into clinical testing.

Your closest partners will be trial planners and Clinical Operations teams, who rely on your analysis to make country allocation and feasibility decisions. You will also work with colleagues in TP-AP, Global Trial Allocation and related R&D functions to align on assumptions, share better practice and develop common analytical standards. The work covers global trials, so you will bring different perspectives together, create clarity and help teams move from insight to decision.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work on complex questions with real influence on how trials are planned. You are trusted to own your work, make your voice heard and shape the standards and tools your colleagues use. You will grow through hands-on project delivery, collaboration across R&D functions and the chance to coach colleagues, in an environment that supports you to perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 651,200 to 956,900, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex data into decisions that help trials move forward, apply for the Trial Insights Manager role by **17 November 2026.

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function. Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• Competitive salary and employment conditions

• A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• An international and collaborative working environment

• Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• Social activities and annual global events

Interested?

Are you interested in the position? Please submit your application and CV via the application button – we look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions about the position and would like to learn more, you are welcome to contact Senior Recruitment Consultant at Actief Hartmanns, Anne-Mette Juncker Davidsen, by phone +45 4121 1344 or by email: anne-mette.davidsen@actief-hartmanns.dk.

Actief Hartmanns A/S is handling the entire recruitment process on behalf of Axlab, and therefore all inquiries should be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion, or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found, even before the application deadline.

About Churney

At Churney, we’re building the signal layer between company data and AI and advertising systems, enabling business-outcome-optimized AI at scale. We help advertisers make smarter, long-term decisions. We've built a system that maximizes Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) by sending predicted lifetime value (pLTV) conversion events to platforms like Google and Meta. The result: better bidding, higher returns and measurable impact.

We’re a small team growing fast, in a research-driven environment with ambitious, highly capable and collaborative teammates. Our ambition is to build the best experimentation culture in the world, and we value shared learning above all else. The impact of your work is directly measurable so you'll have a uniquely fast feedback loop on the outcomes you’re driving.

You’ll be expected to bring high energy, a growth mindset and a deep care for clients.

• You'll be trusted early. You won't spend weeks shadowing. You'll own real client relationships quickly, and what matters is whether those clients grow with Churney.

• We expect you to be hungry to learn the ins and outs of our tech stack, the ad platforms, and how pLTV can improve advertisers across different industries.

The role

You’ll be the technical bridge between Churney and our clients - integrating their data, shaping modeling decisions, running our ML pipelines to turn raw user data into value signals, validating real-world impact in the ad platforms, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience, and guiding clients to adopt our services at scale.

It's a genuinely hybrid role spanning data engineering, ML, ad-platform measurement, and client communication — which means broad exposure to the whole business and the chance to become a domain expert in an industry that turns over hundreds of billions of dollars a year, while working alongside some of the best engineers around.

We are looking for smart, motivated problem solvers who learn fast and want their work to have measurable impact. We welcome both junior and experienced candidates.

What you'll do

• Integrate client data — connect cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and map messy, real-world data into our common data model.

• Configure and run our pLTV pipelines — set up and experiment within our production modeling pipeline to produce pLTV value signals.

• Own measurement and experimentation — design and run experiments (geo, A/B, lift, pre/post), diagnose signal loss and match quality in the Meta and Google interfaces (EMQ, signal ratio), and size the opportunity before launch.

• Validate impact and iterate — analyze results, confirm the signal is driving real ROAS, and tighten the loop.

• Communicate with clients — build a collaborative partnership with the client, present opportunity sizing and results to client stakeholders, proactively resolve issues, and drive adoption at scale.

• Improve the platform — collaborate with client leads and internal teams to automate toil and raise the quality of our tools and processes.

What we're looking for

• Strong Python and SQL — comfortable in large, messy datasets.

• Solid ML foundations — you understand modeling trade-offs even if you're not training models from scratch here.

• Excellent communication — you can explain a technical result to a non-technical client and hold the relationship.

• A measurement mindset (or strong appetite for one) — curiosity about how ad attribution, identifiers, and incrementality actually work.

• Ownership and comfort with ambiguity — you can run multiple client projects at once in a space where the playbook is still being written.

• An automation and improvement instinct — you'd rather fix the workflow than repeat the toil.

Nice to have

• Experience with ad platforms and performance marketing (Google, Meta, TikTok).

• Direct, hands-on client experience.

• Modern cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

• Background in A/B testing, causal inference, or LTV modeling.

• Experience building internal tooling or agentic AI workflows to speed up the above.

If you learn quickly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to apply your data science skills to real, measurable client impact, we'd love to talk.

Apply for this role

Tell us about yourself below, we read every application. You’re also welcome to apply by email at gaja@churney.io.

Do you love turning complex rewards- and people data into clear business insights? And would you like to work at the intersection of Rewards, Finance and People Analytics in an international business?

At Royal Unibrew, we are looking for a Senior Analyst, Rewards to strengthen our global Rewards agenda and bring even more analytical power to how we understand and manage our workforce costs, pay structures and market competitiveness.

This is particularly attractive for an ambitious Rewards professional who is ready to take the next step in their career. A key part of your role will also be supporting our journey towards increased pay transparency, strengthening our governance and ensuring that our approach is both compliant and practical for the business.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive global FTE, headcount and salary cost analysis, including forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis

• Partner with HR and Finance across markets on workforce cost insights and scenario modelling

• Support implementation of the EU Pay Transparency Directive, including pay equity and pay gap analysis

• Strengthen governance around job architecture, salary structures and Rewards data

• Conduct salary benchmarking and analyse market competitiveness across countries

• Provide analytical support for salary review processes

• Develop dashboards and management reporting

**

• Data analytics and large datasets

• Pay Transparency and Pay Equity

• Compensation benchmarking and salary structures

• Job architecture and Rewards governance

You are analytical, structured and curious, with strong business acumen. You enjoy getting into the detail, but you also know how to zoom out, identify what matters and communicate it clearly to stakeholders.

**Why Royal Unibrew?

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

Collaboration and cross-site training with our analytical development group in Utrecht and analytical SME´s in Copenhagen will also be expected in the beginning

**

• Documenting validation activities of analytical methods for clinical phase I/II and III and authoring SOPs.

**

**Why Join Us?

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies.
